name: restaurant-payment-credentials
title: Add restaurant payment provider configuration
description: Let authorized restaurant managers configure encrypted MoMo and VNPAY merchant credentials from the manager UI without editing code or environment files.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Restaurant-scoped credentials apply to reservation/order/POS payment sessions. Customer Cohan Balance topups remain platform-scoped because wallet funds belong to the COHAN platform. The branch was rebased onto main at 8edb635e7e9d11d259db5e0369fd410dcd504b0b. GitHub CI passed backend lint, full tests, Menu RBAC and build; frontend conflict checks, lint, unit tests, changed-component tests, production build and Playwright smoke tests on code commit c66e3f379d1c761fd2b5179e82422c2f0f6f35e5. No live MoMo or VNPAY merchant transaction was executed from CI.
